parsed.summary: The patch addresses the IndexError in the sylow_subgroup method by adding a bounds check before deleting elements from lists. The change is minimal and focused on fixing the reported issue.

issues.description: The patch introduces a minor style inconsistency by using a comma after the if condition, which is not consistent with the rest of the codebase.
